description: New Zealand Earthquake-Damaged Building Envelopes: Photographs from Christchurch and Wellington is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Dave Edkins, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). This project captures earthquake damage to building envelopes due to seismic activity in New Zealand. Two cities central business districts were targeted; Christchurch following the 2010-2011 earthquakes, and Wellington following the 2016 Kaikoura earthquake. Coverage: New Zealand. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: non-structural, pipe lines, building envelopes, seismic damage, survey. Published 2020-06-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
